quantize_to_mxfp4: quantize a bfloat16 tensor to MXFP4 format with round-ceiling block scaling
dequantize_mxfp4_to_dtype: dequantize packed MXFP4 data back to a target dtype like bfloat16 or float32
run_mxfp4_emulation: run an MXFP4 emulation pipeline that quantizes input, dequantizes weight, and performs matmul
run_mxfp4_gemm: run a GEMM operation with MXFP4 quantized input and FP8 unpacked weight
qdq_mxfp4_rounding: quantize and dequantize a tensor using MXFP4 scaled even rounding with block size 32
